notes.title: Heideland GameWorks is closing doors
notes.notes:
Hi,

sadly I have to inform you today that Heideland GameWorks is closing doors.

Than you so much for all the support and for playing the game. It meant the world to me.

If you have purchased the game you will be still able to play and enjoy it.

We never know what the future holds and probably AnShi will come back in future.

Stay safe and kind regards

Andre Ledermueller

notes.title: Double dash? YES PLEASE!
notes.notes:
Just because a single dash does not feel great you can now use double dash! Just jump with hoverboard and then press dash two times. The dashing is reset as soon as you land.

Have fun!
